    <dd>Component name.</dd></dl>
</pulumi-choosable>
</div>

## Import



APM application config can be imported using the instanceId#serviceName, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Apm/applicationConfig:ApplicationConfig example apm-jPr5iQL77#java-order-serive
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
